decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already captures the requirement to edit all four shortlisted takes; the alternate-take preference change requires no additional modification.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures individual delivery of the four edited shortlisted takes, with no omitted update or obsolete attribute.
Preferring Takes Six and Eight and identifying four shortlisted directions does not change the established tone, energy, pride, or overacting constraints.
The source does not modify or remove the requirement that the final sentence flow smoothly without excessive pauses.
